title: Chapter 646 - 646 Teacher And Student Exchange Roles; Classmates!
content:
Chapter 646 - 646 Teacher And Student Exchange Roles; Classmates!

Chapter 646 - 646 Teacher and Student Exchange Roles; Classmates!

646 Teacher and Student Exchange Roles; Classmates!

Chen Zuzhi’s face was filled with anticipation and surprise.

He did not even dare to blink.

In fact, his breathing even stopped for a moment.

Lin Fan placed his hands on the piano keys and started to play.

The melodious and gentle music continued to ripple.

As the music continued, Chen Zuzhi’s eyes lit up.

When Lin Fan stopped playing, Chen Zuzhi started shouting excitedly.

“Good, good, good!”

This showed how happy he was at the moment.

“So that’s how it is!

“Mr. Lin, thank you!”

After saying that, Chen Zuzhi bowed deeply toward Lin Fan.

This scene once again stunned everyone present.

Lin Fan was a student, and Chen Zuzhi was a professor.

At this moment, their identities seemed to be completely reversed.

How could this not be surprising?

Everyone could not help but think of Chen Ming’s words.

“Lin Fan, when you play the piano, you have to pay more attention to your foundation.”

Pay attention to his foundation?

If even Chen Zuzhi regarded Lin Fan as a teacher and he still needed to pay more attention to his foundation…

Then who in this world did not need to pay attention to their foundation?

Chen Ming seemed to have thought of this as well, and his entire face became redder and redder.

…

In the live broadcast room.

Countless comments appeared.

Shi Lei: [Lin Fan’s piano skills are so good.]

No Woman in My Heart: [I’ve never heard such a nice piano piece before.]

Bingxue: [The general managers of the Imperial Hotel are so respectful to Lin Fan. Lin Fan can even get the employees of Yuesse Snow Tea to send drinks to him with a single sentence…Now, he played such a beautiful piano piece, and he’s so handsome! Heavens! He’s simply the perfect Prince Charming!]

Summoning: [I like him!]

Sea of Stars: [Heavens! Professor Chen Zuzhi bowed to him. This… This is unbelievable!]

Quick Guest: [That Chen Ming still wanted to make things difficult for Lin Fan. What a joke. He dug a grave for himself, didn’t he?]

Snowy: [He’s asking for humiliation!]

…

The banquet lasted until 9 PM before it slowly ended.

Today was supposed to be a joyous gathering for the student union committee members.

Later on, it turned into a piano lesson for Chen Zuzhi.

However, the crowd was not annoyed by this.

On the contrary, everyone’s faces were filled with enjoyment.

It was not until the end of the banquet that Xia Xue found that she had been broadcasting live.

Even though she did not speak in the broadcast, she had climbed to the top of the livestream popularity rankings!

This directly shocked Xia Xue.

Who Are You: [Xia Xue finally appears in front of the camera!]

King: [Xiao Xue, can you let Mr. Lin play a few more songs?]

Coming Right Up: [Mr. Lin is a piano genius!]

Wan Jiajia: [Although I really can’t bear to part with Xia Xue, if the other party is Lin Fan, it’s alright with me!]

Conflict: [Xia Xue, you’re so lucky.]

…

Xia Xue looked at the bullet screen in the live broadcast room, and her entire pretty face suddenly blushed.

After a while, she stammered, “Thank you… Thank you, everyone, for your support. Today’s live broadcast will end here.]

After saying that, she immediately ended the live broadcast.

Xia Xue walked on the long forest path. Lin Fan’s figure involuntarily appeared in her mind. As time passed, it became taller, bigger, and brighter.

Xia Xue shook her head hard. Only then did she regain some consciousness and continue to walk forward.

…

A few days passed in a flash.

Today was the first day of school at Jiangbei University.

The new students entered the school, and the older students started classes.

The entire school was very lively, full of vitality and vitality.

At this moment, in classroom 2011.

Since the bell had not rung, the students sat very casually.

In twos and threes, their arms were around each other’s shoulders as they chatted about interesting things that took place during the holidays.

“I finally passed the tenth level of Sprinting Rush during the summer vacation. It’s so exciting!”

“F*ck, you’re that awesome? I can’t even pass the sixth level.”

“I’ve passed the ninth level. Let’s team up next time!”

…

“When we entered the school, we didn’t know anything. Many beautiful girls and handsome guys were snatched away by our seniors. I wonder if there’ll be any handsome guys or beautiful girls entering this year.”

“Hehe, after class, we’ll go help our juniors with some small things.”

…

“I heard that there’s a very good restaurant on Grain Street. How about going there when we’re free?”

“Alright!”

…

Some people were chatting, while others were quietly organizing their books.

For example, Xia Xue.

Even though it was the first day of school, she did not slack off at all. She was still seriously flipping through the books that had just been distributed.

At this moment, the bell rang in Jiangbei University.

The students, who had their arms around each other’s shoulders, could not help but disperse and return to their seats.

Not long after, a dull sound of footsteps could be heard from outside the corridor.

Following that, a middle-aged man dressed in a white shirt called Qin Chuan, who looked very capable, strode in.

“Long time no see, my fellow students!” he said with a smile.”

As he spoke, he glanced at everyone in the classroom and nodded slightly. “Very good. Not a single person is missing this year.”

A thousand years ago, if a teacher wanted to know if a student had come to the classroom, they had to count or do a roll call.

However, a thousand years later, some teachers had special abilities or strong spiritual power.

With just a glance, they could tell the situation of the people in the classroom.

This saved them a lot of trouble. At the same time, it also made skipping classes a thing of the past.

“Actually, not only is there no one missing, but from this semester onward, our class will have one more student.”

Then, he said to the door, “Lin Fan, come in.”

Originally, Xia Xue, who was still flipping through the book, could not help but prick up her ears.

For some reason, her heart suddenly beat faster, and she could not help but raise her head.

In the next moment…

A tall and handsome figure appeared on the podium.

It was Lin Fan!

Xia Xue’s heart beat faster again.

‘It’s him! It’s him! It’s really him!’

Xia Xue almost couldn’t believe her eyes.

Since the end of the banquet, Xia Xue had never seen Lin Fan again.

She had also thought about sending a message to Lin Fan.

However, after a few moments of hesitation, she could not send it out.

In the past few days, Xia Xue had been thinking about when she would see Lin Fan again.

However, she never thought that it would be today, in the classroom!

Was Lin Fan not a new student?

How did he become her classmate?

Classmates?

For some reason, Xia Xue thought of this word, and her heartbeat sped up again.
